summary: Phase 81.78 Auto-scroll fix + Enter-to-Next navigation - All features verified. (1) After clicking Start, window.scrollY stays at 0 and Next button remains visible at top. (2) Enter key on single-line text fields advances to next field. (3) Code review confirms textarea (multi-line) fields allow newlines on Enter without advancing.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ InteractiveDocumentViewer.js: scrollFieldIntoContainer helper (lines 401-429) scrolls ONLY within scrollContainerRef, not window - fixes auto-scroll bug
✅ InteractiveDocumentViewer.js: onEnterNext prop added (line 84) and called from container-level onKeyDown (line 1671)
✅ InteractiveDocumentViewer.js: Container onKeyDown (lines 1650-1673) handles Enter for INPUT elements (text/date/number) but skips TEXTAREA and BUTTON
✅ InteractiveDocumentViewer.js: Per-field handleKeyDown (lines 870-877) calls e.preventDefault() for single-line text only, allowing multi-line to insert newlines
✅ useGuidedFillIn.js: goToNext function unchanged - advances to next unfilled navigable field
